# Polytician 3.0 MCP contract

`contract.json` is Polytician 3.0.0's MCP contract as AgentVault's client sees it, recorded from the real server over stdio: the handshake (accepted protocol versions, calls without `notifications/initialized`), the `tools/list` entries for the tools AgentVault calls or should call, real request/response pairs for `save_concept`, `search_concepts`, `read_concept`, `list_concepts`, `delete_concept`, `get_stats` and `health_check`, and the errors AgentVault's current calls get (2.x arguments, unknown ids, removed 2.x tools, `vault_*` tools with AgentVault unconfigured and unreachable). `source.volatile` says which values were replaced for stable assertions and which are model-dependent.

To re-capture, build Polytician and run `POLYTICIAN_MODELS_DIR=<dir holding Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2> node tests/fixtures/polytician-3.0/capture.mjs --out tests/fixtures/polytician-3.0/contract.json --date YYYY-MM-DD -- node <polytician>/dist/index.js` (or put the command in `POLYTICIAN_ENTRY`). Every server run gets a fresh temporary data directory and `HOME` and no inherited `POLYTICIAN_*` settings, and the `vault_*` run points at a closed loopback port, so no real data is touched and nothing leaves the machine. Without `POLYTICIAN_MODELS_DIR` the server downloads the embedding model (~25 MB); two captures of the same build are byte-identical.

`fake-server.mjs` is a stdio MCP server built from `contract.json` for AgentVault's tests (`tests/integration/polytician-contract.test.ts`, `tests/cli/commands/polytician.test.ts`). It answers `initialize` with the protocol versions the real server accepted, lists the captured tools, validates every `tools/call` against the captured `inputSchema` (unknown keys rejected, required keys enforced) with the real server's `VALIDATION_ERROR` messages, and answers valid calls with the recorded responses. Options switch on the `vault_*` tools (`--vault unreachable` replays the recorded `UPSTREAM_ERROR`; `--vault ok` answers with synthesized results checked against the captured `outputSchema`), log what it receives (`--log`), fail one tool (`--fail`), answer a given protocol version (`--protocol`), exit before answering (`--exit-on-start`), ping the client mid-call (`--ping`), split each message inside a multi-byte UTF-8 character across two writes (`--split-utf8`), start with no concepts (`--empty`), make a concept unreadable while search still returns it (`--forget`) or never answer one tool (`--hang`). The contract test checks that it reproduces every recorded response. `tests/integration/polytician-real.test.ts` runs the same flows against a real server when `POLYTICIAN_ENTRY` (and optionally `POLYTICIAN_MODELS_DIR`) is set.
